# QGA Lab

Independent research stack for quaternion orders, Hopf geometry, and photonic OAM analogs.

Maintainer: [Aaron Michael Kinder](https://github.com/kinaar8340)  
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-6765-9813

This organization is the **citable spine**.  
Exploratory notes, alignment writing, and unfinished satellites stay on the personal account and are **not** part of this stack:
https://github.com/kinaar8340

## Repositories

| Repo | Role | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| [flux_hopf_lib](https://github.com/qga-lab/flux_hopf_lib) | Shared math, source of truth | QGA book labs, GPU runtime |
| [qga](https://github.com/qga-lab/qga) | Manuscript spine (theorems) | Empirical attacks, product claims |
| [qga_engine](https://github.com/qga-lab/qga_engine) | Sims / Rust port | Swapchain ownership |
| [qga_gpu](https://github.com/qga-lab/qga_gpu) | Frame / upload path | World meaning |
| [oam_flux](https://github.com/qga-lab/oam_flux) | Helical OAM + Hopf lattice synthesis | Geometry proofs, arXiv package |

`oam_bridge` remains on the personal account as the isolated [arXiv:2607.16520](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.16520) analog. It is not part of this org spine.

Geometry and arithmetic stay theorems. Physical models stay models.
